policy: Frozen before the implementation. Old B2 is main 3c81178; new B2 is this branch. Targets: every real-PDF step PR #98 refused for content on the line of a following paragraph's placed object or for its collision, and C02's PR #92 lengthen. Capacity and missing-glyph refusals stay refused and are not targets. A decoration moves only when its candidate id is approved explicitly; acknowledge_inference alone never approves one. A refusal ends its case and never counts as success; fixture successes are reported apart from real-PDF successes.
procedure: propose; record the listed decoration candidates
save without approving them (a step needing one must be refused)
save approving exactly the listed candidates
undo from the saved PDF alone, approving the candidates its proposal lists
measures: saved or refused (reason); the existing audits (safety, quality: indesign_evaluate.audit over the edited and following paragraphs), structure, continued editing; placed audit (approved moves exact and nothing left, protected paint unchanged); links (targets kept, moved clickable areas translated exactly, others unchanged); raster of the moved group (MuPDF, whole-pixel translation, pixel for pixel); undo against the source
